review: 701.10f-1: the Cube's {3} payment was unfixed and could have spent the {R} from the pool; the decision now pays it with the Forests' {G}{G}{G}.
701.10g-2: the scenario had no does_not_fire variant; without_furnace (damage not doubled) relabelled from other to does_not_fire.

scenarios.title: Doubling modifies power instead of setting it, so a later base-power effect still shows the bonus
decisions: A casts Unleash Fury targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Mountains.
Both players pass; Unleash Fury resolves.
A casts Humble targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Plains.
Both players pass; Humble resolves.

variants.label: fury_then_humble
variants.expected: After Unleash Fury, Grizzly Bears is 4/2. After Humble sets its base power and toughness to 0/1 and removes its abilities, Grizzly Bears is 2/1: the +2/+0 from the doubling is still applied on top of the new base.

variants.label: humble_then_fury
variants.delta: A casts and resolves Humble first, then Unleash Fury.
variants.expected: After Humble, Grizzly Bears is 0/1. Unleash Fury doubles a power of 0, giving +0/+0. Grizzly Bears is 0/1.

scenarios.title: Doubling a creature's power adds its power as the spell resolves
decisions: A casts Unleash Fury targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Mountains.
Both players pass; Unleash Fury resolves.

variants.label: plain
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears (2/2) gets +2/+0 and is 4/2 until end of turn. Toughness is unchanged.

variants.label: zero_power
variants.delta: Unleash Fury targets B's Wall of Wood (0/3) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Wall of Wood gets +0/+0 and stays 0/3.

variants.label: pump_in_response
variants.delta: With Unleash Fury on the stack, A casts Giant Growth targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest. Giant Growth resolves first.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is 5/5 when Unleash Fury resolves, so it gets +5/+0. Grizzly Bears is 10/5 until end of turn.

variants.label: pump_after
variants.delta: A casts Giant Growth targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Forest, only after Unleash Fury has resolved.
variants.expected: Unleash Fury resolves on a 2/2 and gives +2/+0 (4/2). Giant Growth then gives +3/+3. Grizzly Bears is 7/5 until end of turn.

scenarios.title: Doubling power and toughness together gives +X/+Y with X the power and Y the toughness

setup.notes: Tifa's Limit Break is a tiered spell: its total cost is {G} plus the chosen tier's cost.

decisions: A casts Tifa's Limit Break choosing the Meteor Strikes tier ({2}), targeting Hill Giant, paying {G}{2} with Forest and both Mountains.
Both players pass; Tifa's Limit Break resolves.

variants.label: double_both
variants.expected: Hill Giant (3/3) gets +3/+3 and is 6/6 until end of turn.

variants.label: double_power_only
variants.delta: A casts Unleash Fury targeting Hill Giant, tapping both Mountains, instead of Tifa's Limit Break.
variants.expected: Hill Giant gets +3/+0 and is 6/3 until end of turn. Toughness is unchanged.

variants.label: flat_bonus_tier
variants.delta: A casts Tifa's Limit Break choosing the Somersault tier ({0}) instead of Meteor Strikes, paying only {G} with Forest.
variants.expected: Hill Giant gets +2/+2 and is 5/5 until end of turn: nothing is doubled.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the tiers as a Charm with ModeCost; the chosen tier's cost is added to {G}.

scenarios.title: Doubling a negative power gives a further negative modifier

setup.notes: Wall of Wood with Dead Weight is -2/1.

decisions: A casts Unleash Fury targeting Wall of Wood, tapping both Mountains.
Both players pass; Unleash Fury resolves.

variants.label: negative_power
variants.expected: Wall of Wood (-2/1 with Dead Weight) gets -2/-0 and is -4/1 until end of turn.

variants.label: zero_power
variants.delta: Dead Weight is not on the battlefield, so Wall of Wood is 0/3.
variants.expected: Wall of Wood gets +0/+0 and stays 0/3.

variants.label: mixed_signs
variants.delta: A casts Tifa's Limit Break choosing the Meteor Strikes tier ({2}) instead of Unleash Fury, paying {G}{2} with Forest and both Mountains.
variants.expected: Power -2 doubles to -2/-0 and toughness 1 doubles to +0/+1. Wall of Wood is -4/2 until end of turn.

scenarios.forge_notes: A power below zero is only reachable with an effect that lowers power while leaving toughness positive; the toughness-below-zero branch of 701.10c cannot be reached because the creature dies first.

scenarios.title: Doubling a player's life total gains life equal to the current total

setup.notes: In the cannot_gain_life variant Everlasting Torment is added to B's battlefield.

decisions: A casts Beacon of Immortality targeting A, tapping six Plains.
Both players pass; Beacon of Immortality resolves.

variants.label: target_self
variants.expected: A's life total goes from 15 to 30. Beacon of Immortality is shuffled into A's library.

variants.label: target_opponent
variants.delta: Beacon of Immortality targets B instead of A.
variants.expected: B's life total goes from 9 to 18. A's life stays 15. Beacon of Immortality is shuffled into A's library.

variants.label: cannot_gain_life
variants.delta: Everlasting Torment is on the battlefield under B's control (players can't gain life).
variants.expected: A's life total stays 15. Beacon of Immortality is still shuffled into A's library.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the card as SetLife; whether the can't-gain-life effect blocks the increase is the Forge behaviour to check.

scenarios.title: Doubling counters gives as many more of each kind as are already there
decisions: A activates Aetheric Amplifier's second ability ({4}, {T}), tapping four Forests, choosing the mode that doubles counters on a target permanent, targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: permanent_two_kinds
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears goes from 2 +1/+1 counters and 1 charge counter to 4 +1/+1 counters and 2 charge counters. It is 6/6.

variants.label: no_counters
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has no counters and stays 2/2.

variants.label: player_counters
variants.delta: A chooses the mode that doubles the counters A has instead of targeting a permanent.
variants.expected: A's energy counters go from 2 to 4. Grizzly Bears' counters are unchanged (4/4).

scenarios.forge_notes: Players' energy counters may have to be set through Forge's puzzle format.

scenarios.title: Doubling unspent mana adds the amount already in the pool
decisions: A taps Mountain for {R}; the mana stays in A's pool.
A activates Doubling Cube ({3}, {T}), tapping the three Forests and paying {3} with the {G}{G}{G} they produce, so the {R} stays in A's pool.
A casts Shock targeting B, paying {R} from the pool.
A casts the second Shock targeting B, paying {R} from the pool.
Both players pass; both Shocks resolve.

variants.label: mana_in_pool
variants.expected: The pool holds {R} when Doubling Cube resolves and {R}{R} afterwards, so both Shocks are cast. B takes 4 damage and is at 16. Both Shocks are in A's graveyard.

variants.label: empty_pool
variants.delta: A activates Doubling Cube first, with an empty pool, and only then taps Mountain for {R}.
variants.expected: Doubling Cube adds nothing. A has only {R}, so only the first Shock is cast. B takes 2 damage and is at 18. The second Shock stays in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Doubling Cube is a mana ability in Forge (it does not use the stack); the pool must be kept within the main phase.

scenarios.title: A replacement effect that doubles damage applies to a creature source but not to a spell
decisions: A moves to combat and attacks B with Grizzly Bears.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: creature_source
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears would deal 2 damage to B and deals 4 instead. B is at 16.

variants.label: spell_source
variants.delta: A does not attack; A casts Shock targeting B, tapping Mountain, and Shock resolves.
variants.expected: Shock is not a creature, so its damage is not doubled. B takes 2 damage and is at 18.

scenarios.title: A replacement effect that doubles damage turns non-lethal damage into lethal damage
decisions: A casts Shock targeting Hill Giant, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves.

variants.label: with_furnace
variants.expected: Shock would deal 2 damage and deals 4 instead. Hill Giant (3/3) is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard.

variants.label: without_furnace
variants.delta: Furnace of Rath is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage. Hill Giant stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

variants.label: player_target
variants.delta: Shock targets B instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Shock deals 4 damage to B, who is at 16. Hill Giant is untouched.
